MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  2026 - CAST(date_part('year', CAST(replace(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) AS INT64) - CASE WHEN date_part('month', CAST(replace(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) > 10 OR (date_part('month', CAST(replace(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) = 10 AND date_part('day', CAST(replace(p.birth_date, '/', '-') AS DATE)) > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
